name: Boku no Hitozuma Onee-san ~M na Hitozuma x S na Miboujin~
original_name: ぼくの人妻お姉さん～Mな人妻×Sな未亡人～
source: The protagonist, Narusawa Yuu, is a beautiful boy with a delicate appearance, admired by female students but only interested in older women. One summer day, he falls in love with his best friend's mother, a married woman named Reiko with an excessive amount of pheromones. Yuu's strong desire is reciprocated by Reiko, who is also unsatisfied with her sex life with her older husband. They soon cross the generation gap and become very close. Reiko's dangerous and seductive sister, Tomoka, who becomes alluring when drunk, also gets involved in their triangle love affair which blooms during summer vacation. The story follows the forbidden love of Yusuke and his questionable decisions.
translation: 主角鸣泽优是一个外表精致的美少年，深受女学生的崇拜，但只对年长的女性感兴趣。一个夏天的一天，他爱上了他最好朋友的母亲，一位名叫玲子的已婚妇女，身上含有过量的信息素。Yuu的强烈愿望得到了Reiko的回应，她也对与年长丈夫的性生活不满意。他们很快就跨越了代沟，变得非常亲密。玲子危险又妖媚的妹妹智花，醉酒后变得妖艳，也卷入了暑假期间绽放的三角恋。故事讲述了佑介的禁忌之爱和他可疑的决定。
